rule: Only government-published coordinates: office name, latitude and longitude from the same official row. No geocoding (VWorld, Kakao, Naver, Google, OSM), no manual map coordinates, no scraping, no estimates, no representative-point substitution.

targets.note: No government dataset found that publishes 서울특별시청 with latitude/longitude (data.go.kr by city, by host district 중구 and nationally; 서울 열린데이터광장). OA-12991 lists names/addresses only; OA-20961 is planning-facility zoning, not an office point.

source.coordinate_crs: not stated by the source; decimal degrees used as WGS84 (EPSG:4326) without transformation

targets.note: Headquarters row: the source row names 부산광역시청 together with 부산광역시의회 (the city council) — one row, one point, one address (중앙대로 1001), which is the city-hall complex; no other row in the source names the city hall. The published point is kept as is.

No coordinate-bearing government source found. 대구광역시_공공기관 및 관공서 리스트 (data.go.kr 15111262) lists 대구광역시청 with two campuses (동인청사 중구 공평로 88 / 산격청사 북구 연암로 40) and no coordinates; a future coordinate source would also need headquarters semantics, else AMBIGUOUS_OFFICE.
인천광역시_행정기관 현황 (15013638) and 인천광역시_공공청사 도로명주소 현황 (15048910) list 인천광역시청 (남동구 정각로 29) with an address only — no coordinates; no coordinate-bearing source found.

No coordinate-bearing government source lists 광주광역시청 (host district 서구: 우리동네생활지도 15134842 has coordinates but no city-hall row). data.go.kr provider names now read 전남광주통합특별시 (docs/evidence/v03_admin_vintage_changes.csv); the V0.2 unit SGIS-24 (SGIS 2025_2Q) is unchanged.
No coordinate-bearing government source lists 대전광역시청 (host district 서구 publishes no public-institution list; 대전광역시_청사 시설 및 설비현황 15081279 has building facts, no coordinates).
No coordinate-bearing government source lists 울산광역시청 (the 울주군 방사능방재 생활기반시설 layer 15095521 covers 남구 offices incl. 남구청, not 울산광역시청).
